svg.text: The crew's house: the den, the loft, the tabk bay and the outer rooms, as the game builds them
THE BUNKS · six bunk beds under the rafters
THE TABK BAY · 993 × 180, scrolls sideways (tabks 1.5× here)
THE OUTER ROOMS · each its own screen, behind a door
down the trapdoor in front of the couch
down through the hole in B1's floor
THE LOFT'S OWN ROOMS · the loft is the way in
tarped until its crewmate moves in
a way in: the same number on both ends
In the game's art pixels, to scale. From Core/Lobby/DenMap.cs, BayMap.cs and Ui/Den/DenRoom.cs; the design is docs/design/lobby.md.
The outer rooms are their own screens, each one behind a door; the badges mark the two ends of each way in. The bay has no ladder: the lift is the only way up to the top deck.
